title: Qualitative Research Methods
subtitle: a graduate-level guide from paradigm to defensible finding, with a design selector, a coding walkthrough and a rigor self-check
problem: Doctoral students and practitioner-researchers choose a qualitative design by habit — interviews because interviews are familiar — and reach the defence unable to say which paradigm they stand in, why their sample is adequate, or what makes their themes trustworthy. Textbooks cover each piece; few let a reader try the decisions.
solution: An eighteen-section resource that moves from paradigms through the five approaches, sampling, data collection, analysis and trustworthiness to writing up, with widgets that make the reader decide: a design selector that suggests an approach from three answers, a coding walkthrough that lifts one quote from datum to theme, a rigor scorer over Lincoln and Guba's criteria, and a self-quiz matching questions to approaches.
pedagogy: decisions before definitions: the design selector, coding ladder and rigor scorer each ask the reader to commit before the page explains; a glossary and FAQ close the loop; sections are collapsible so the executive summary reads in two minutes.

widgets.name: Approach tabs
widgets.what: Five tabs (narrative, phenomenology, grounded theory, ethnography, case study) switch the detail panel

widgets.name: Design selector
widgets.what: Three questions about intent; tallies the answers and suggests an approach with a rationale, flagging split answers

widgets.name: Coding walkthrough
widgets.what: Steps one participant quote up four rungs — raw datum, code, category, theme — with a hint per rung

widgets.name: Rigor scorer
widgets.what: Weighted checklist of nine trustworthiness strategies; fills a bar and gives an Emerging / Solid / Strong verdict

widgets.name: Self-quiz
widgets.what: Five research questions to match to the right approach, with the correct answer revealed on a miss

widgets.name: FAQ accordion
widgets.what: Expandable answers to common design questions

quiz_topics: the constructivist paradigm and its neighbours
tour: the first section opens and the count rises.
paradigms, sampling, saturation, trustworthiness and coding
